tasks.instruction: Recline on a picnic blanket propped on one elbow, holding a paperback book open with the other hand while reading, legs relaxed and crossed at the ankle
tasks.camera: medium wide shot from a low three-quarter angle
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands and all fingers clearly visible above the blanket; feet partly hidden
tasks.intent_zh: 躺在野餐垫上撑肘看书

tasks.instruction: Lie on back on a sofa with knees bent, tossing a small ball straight up and reaching to catch it, palm open upward and fingers spread
tasks.camera: full body shot from the side at sofa level
tasks.visibility_requirement: Catching hand palm and all five fingers facing camera; other hand at rest visible

tasks.instruction: Sit reclined against a large cushion, one leg extended showing the sole toward the viewer with yellow pads, using a pencil to sketch in a notebook on the raised knee
tasks.camera: low frontal shot framing the extended foot and hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Extended sole fully facing camera with all four toes and pads clear; sketch hand visible
tasks.intent_zh: 靠着垫子伸腿露脚掌画画

tasks.instruction: Lie stomach-down on a rug, chin propped on one hand, scrolling a phone with the other thumb, tail curling upward behind
tasks.camera: high angle shot looking down along the body
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands near face clearly visible, fingers distinct around the phone

tasks.instruction: Recline sideways on a chaise longue, fanning himself with a folded paper fan held high, other arm draped over the backrest
tasks.camera: medium side shot from slightly below
tasks.visibility_requirement: Fan-holding hand and draped hand both fully visible with fingers

tasks.instruction: Lie on back on grass with arms folded behind head, one knee raised, gazing at clouds, tail stretched out to the side
tasks.camera: wide overhead shot looking straight down
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands tucked behind head but fingers visible against the grass

tasks.instruction: Sit reclined on floor leaning back on both palms planted behind him, legs stretched forward with one sole tilted up showing pads

tasks.visibility_requirement: Both planted palms open with fingers spread and one sole with all toes and pads clear
tasks.intent_zh: 坐地撑手掌并翘起一只脚掌

tasks.instruction: Lie on side on a bed reading a magazine spread on the mattress, one hand flipping a page, the other resting flat showing the palm up

tasks.intent_zh: 侧躺床上翻杂志露手掌

tasks.instruction: Recline in a hammock with feet hanging out one end, one foot sole facing forward toward the camera, hands clasped behind head

tasks.visibility_requirement: Hanging sole fully clear with four toes and pads; clasped hands visible

tasks.instruction: Lie on stomach at a low table propped on elbows, writing a letter with a pen, the other hand flattening the paper, feet crossed behind
tasks.camera: over-the-shoulder medium shot
tasks.visibility_requirement: Writing hand and flattening hand both clear with distinct fingers

tasks.instruction: Recline on a beanbag with a guitar across his lap, one hand fretting the neck, the other strumming, one foot planted showing its sole
tasks.camera: medium wide frontal shot

tasks.instruction: Lie on back with a small dog resting on his chest, one hand stroking it with fingers visible, the other arm relaxed beside him

tasks.visibility_requirement: Stroking hand fingers clearly visible on the dog; relaxed hand visible

tasks.instruction: Sit reclined against a tree trunk with a bowl of snacks, picking one up with thumb and forefinger, the other palm resting open on his knee
tasks.camera: medium three-quarter shot at seated eye level
tasks.visibility_requirement: Pinching fingers and open palm both clearly visible

tasks.instruction: Lie on side on a yoga mat, head on a small pillow, one hand pressing a phone to his ear, the opposite sole propped against the mat edge showing pads
tasks.camera: low side shot
tasks.visibility_requirement: Phone hand fingers clear; propped sole with four toes and pads fully visible

tasks.instruction: Recline on a couch with a remote in one hand, clicking it, other hand behind his head, ankles crossed with one sole turned to camera
tasks.camera: medium frontal shot framing feet and hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Remote hand fingers visible; turned sole fully clear with toes and pads
